correction_rationale: Historical PASS ratings cited unit mock tests (FWiredTree / FakeReopenModel) rather than live COMSOL engine execution. Production code contained critical numerical and indexing defects (F01-F12) that returned incorrect values under unit stubs.

corrections.name: Measures & Axisymmetric 2*pi*r Weighting
corrections.defect_summary: All aggregates mapped to IntVolume regardless of geometric dimension; average denominator hardcoded to 1.0; std and rms formulas unimplemented; axisymmetric count boolean reflection only.

corrections.name: Complex Field Transformation Modes
corrections.defect_summary: _transform_complex_data silently padded 0.0 when imag extraction failed, masking complex data errors as real numbers.

corrections.name: SolutionSpec Inner/Outer & Time Indexing
corrections.defect_summary: Sliced outer array [expr][solnum][vertex] as inner-1, mistakenly slicing expression axis instead of solution step; hardcoded outer_indices=[1].

corrections.name: Large Array Export & Chunk Pagination
corrections.defect_summary: Path(dest).resolve() unconstrained; failed evaluations exported successful empty files; verify_artifact_chunks loaded entire file in RAM; no bounded memory chunk stream.

corrections.name: Identical-SHA Model Reopen
corrections.defect_summary: FakeReopenModel used static byte fixtures and string inequality comparisons; no live COMSOL file reopen without re-solve was performed.
